# QQ plot of residuals

<small>Source: [`R/plotDiagnostics.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/plotDiagnostics.R) · Help: `?plotResidualQQ`</small>

Visualises departure from normality using a QQ plot.

## Usage

```r
plotResidualQQ(model)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted model of class `lm` or `glm`.

## Value

A `ggplot` object.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
plotResidualQQ(m)
```
